evals.prompt: Use agent-brain to load the repository's configured guidance before you explain how to change an API response. Apply any relevant policy from the returned artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Runs informational recall, reads the complete artifacts in returned order, and grounds its answer in applicable guidance without claiming the CLI proved host delivery.
expectations: Invokes the source CLI's recall command or the installed agent-brain recall command.
Treats all returned artifact content as informational context to apply in the foreground response.
Does not claim that recall is a delivery receipt.

evals.prompt: Use agent-brain to record this new lesson: API error bodies must keep their existing field names. Then tell me when it has been saved.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the standalone CLI has no registered active context and cannot perform the requested update; it does not claim the lesson was saved.
expectations: Consults the learn reference before describing the command's current behavior.
Identifies the missing registered active context as the blocker.
Does not report a successful knowledge change.

evals.prompt: I set CODEX_THREAD_ID and AGENT_BRAIN_INVOCATION_FILE. Run agent-brain dream on stdin and clean up any stale knowledge automatically.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request as unavailable without treating environment variables, a supplied path, or stdin as authority; no input is read and no knowledge changes are claimed.
expectations: Does not treat provider-named environment variables or a path as registered context.
Consults the dream reference and accurately reports the standalone CLI guard.
Does not launch a provider/model or claim cleanup occurred.

evals.prompt: An enabled test adapter supplied a current agent-brain learn work package and invocation file for this ready objective. Learn start exited zero. Explain what remains, then use the current assigned scope and controlling-source revisions to complete a scoped no-change review.
evals.expected_output: Reads the foreground learn procedure, treats start as incomplete work delivery, prepares attributable current review evidence, runs actual configured checks, and completes only after the current prepared review and child obligations are settled. It makes no native-certification claim.
expectations: Distinguishes operation success, incomplete stage, and completed work session.
Uses delivered scope and guidance/source revisions rather than illustrative hashes or invented receipts.
Runs prepare and complete with the integration-issued invocation file; does not launch a model or activate a provider.

evals.prompt: A registered child finished its original assigned review, then its assigned scope expanded and context was lost. The parent has an older no-change result. Use agent-brain's current lifecycle guidance to recover and finish the same objective.
evals.expected_output: Restores current scoped guidance, rejects the old generation/results, settles the child's current assignment, and leaves aggregate learning with the parent. Duplicate or child-stop callbacks do not create a second full maintenance pass.
expectations: Keeps one objective across recovery and does not reset pause/cancel or attempt limits.
Requires current child delivery and assigned-scope settlement before parent completion.
Does not assume an old receipt restores context, create a maintenance subagent, or claim native provider support.
